coverage.evidence: dashboard/src/layouts/dashboard/navigation.ts:177-202 puts dashboard-pick-lists in the build group (en.json:936 'Build'); PickListsView.vue:111-116 shows New pick list only with picklists:write; PickListDialog.vue:85-120 has the title, description, Name, Description and Entries fields, with Add pick list or Save pick list from picklists/i18n/en.json:21-30; pickListForm.ts:38-43 splits entries one per non-empty trimmed line; PickListDialog.vue:57-76 keeps the dialog open with the reason on a refusal; PickListService.cs:357-358 and 242-246 store the cleaned entries.

PickListsController.cs:25-29 and 47-181 back the list with {list.pick.<name>}; LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:242-280 replaces each {list.pick.<name>} with PickRandomAsync and returns an empty string for a missing or empty list; TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:650 registers the helper in AllContexts; PickListService.cs:386-421 counts only pipeline steps as the delete blast radius, shown by blastLines.ts:41-50 with en.json:174 '{count} {what}: {names}' and en.json:180 'pipeline steps', or picklists/i18n/en.json:17 'No pipeline step uses this list.'

PickListService.cs:242-246 overwrites Name, Description and Items on update; PickListService.cs:286-299 looks the list up by exact name on every pick; PickListService.cs:268-271 soft-deletes, and lookups at 289 filter DeletedAt == null, so the old name or a deleted list no longer resolves (helper empty per LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:270, step fails per PickFromListAction.cs:87-90).

PickFromListAction.cs:49-63 defines the list field (PickList, Required) and the variable field (default 'pick'); PickFromListAction.cs:82-101 draws once, resolves the entry through ITemplateResolver and stores it in ctx.Variables; failures pass on the service messages 'Pick list 'x' was not found.' (Errors.cs:31-32) and 'Pick list 'x' is empty.' (PickListService.cs:297); PipelineEngine.cs:945 stops unless ContinueOnError; RunSteps.vue:46-78 shows 'What each step did', Failed and the error in text-destructive.

reader_answers.evidence: The create steps match PickListsView.vue:111-116, PickListDialog.vue:94-120 and picklists/i18n/en.json:11,24-29; the name pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$ is at PickListService.cs:379; the helper and the Pick from list step match PickListRow.vue:33 and schema/en.json:3539.

ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:506-508 sets picklists:read and write to Mod with a Vip floor and delete to Mod only; the levels are at ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:50-53 (Mod 10, LeadModerator 20, Editor 30, Broadcaster 40). Case-sensitive exact-name matching is at PickListService.cs:128 and 289.

PickListDialog.vue:76 closes on success; PickListService.cs:82 sorts by name; PickListRow.vue:30-37 builds the row as entries · {list.pick.name} · description, with picklists/i18n/en.json:6; PickFromListAction.cs:92-101 draws once and keeps the value, while LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:261-271 draws again for each placeholder.

UpdateAsync replaces Items (PickListService.cs:244), and every draw reads the current row by name (PickListService.cs:286-299), so later picks from every command, timer or pipeline use the new entries.
